'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
